_about: T326: THE TIDAL LIMIT of every ocean-entering water, one row per blue line: `mouth` (an alias at the mouth, no cut), `split` (an existing splits.json cut), `cut` (a new cut, its id derived from the point), or `whole` (the item is tidal along its whole length). Rows with a `mark` are written from the Tidal-tab marks by `python -m pipeline.tools.tidal_limits` (review write-through) — never edit them by hand; rows without one are the owner's own calls and are kept. Read by the atlas only (`pipeline.atlas.splits.tidal`).

waters.name: San Juan River
waters.why: owner 2026-11-11 accepted the San Juan Bridge as the tidal boundary (T678), source DFO Area 20 (https://www.pac.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/fm-gp/rec/tidal-maree/a-s20-eng.html, data/source/dfo_tidal_areas/2026-11-11): "In that portion of Subarea 20-2 at the mouth of the San Juan River north of the beach camp boundary marker at the large alder tree, located at 48° 33.514' N and 124° 24.272' W and south of the Pacheedaht Campground and a boundary marker located at 48° 33.599' N and 124°24.233' W, at the well-established stump in the sand, shoreward in a easterly direction of this boundary and downstream of the San Juan Bridge." The bridge on the main stem (OSM Deering Road, 48.5600 N 124.3989 W) stands at this blue line's lower end (9 m from it): the limit is the mouth, nothing on the main stem is tidal (a cut on a line's end is refused). The other Deering Road bridge (48.5811 N 124.3948 W) crosses the side channel 354087703 at 681 m, not this line.
